factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'We ended the year with a strong Q4 2025, with net new ARR of DKK 3.1M, compared to DKK 1.8M in the corresponding quarter in 2024. For the full year 2025, Impero's net new ARR was DKK 7.5M compared to net new ARR of DKK 8.3M in the full year 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Profitability improved substantially.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: 'Impero's operating profit amounted to negative DKK 6.8M in 2025, which is an improvement of DKK 4.6M from negative DKK 11.4M in 2024... EBITDA amounted to negative DKK 3.1M in 2025 which is an improvement of DKK 5.6M from negative DKK 8.7M in 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Management attributed the improvement primarily to 19% revenue growth combined with lower increases in staff costs and other external expenses, which rose 6% each.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: 'This is primarily a result of the revenue increase of 19% compared to the lower increase in staff costs and other external expenses of 6%.' Income statement notes: 'Staff costs increased by 6%... Other external expenses increased by 6% compared to 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Cost of sales decreased 16%, increasing the contribution margin to 98% from 97%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: 'Cost of sales decreased by 16% compared to 2024, leading to a positive development in the contribution margin, reaching 98% in 2025 compared to 97% in 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: The reported net loss improved to DKK 6.8 million from DKK 11.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income statement: 'Profit/loss for the period (2025) DKK -6,835T vs (2024) DKK -11,447T.' Financial review: 'Operating profit/loss (EBIT) amounted to negative DKK 6.8M in 2025... from negative DKK 11.4M in 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Capitalized development costs increased to DKK 5.2 million from DKK 3.6 million, reflecting greater investment in new platform features and positively affecting EBITDA.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial review: 'Activation of development costs of DKK 5.2M in 2025 had a positive impact on EBITDA. This is an increase from DKK 3.6M in 2024 due to increased focus on developing new features.' Income statement note 1: 'Own work capitalized DKK 5,190T (2025) vs DKK 3,621T (2024).'

factual_claims.claim: SaaS metrics remained strong, although some efficiency indicators weakened.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'SaaS metrics remained strong, although some efficiency indicators weakened... Churn fell to 1%... Net revenue retention was 106% down from 108%... CAC payback increased to 22 months from 15 months...'

factual_claims.claim: Churn fell to 1% from 2%, and there was no churn in the DACH region.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights: 'Impero's ARR growth rate of 19% YoY was in the upper end of the revised ARR growth range of 11-19%, in line with Company Announcement No. 19-2025. EBITDA ended at DKK -3.1M... with an exceptionally low churn rate of 1% in 2025.' ARR development: 'In 2025, we had an exceptionally low churn of DKK 0.4M, corresponding to 1%... including no churn across our customer base in the DACH region.'

factual_claims.claim: Net revenue retention was 106%, down from 108%, while net uplift declined to 7% from 10%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics table: 'Net Revenue Retention (NRR) 106% (2025) vs 108% (2024). Net Uplift 7% (2025) vs 10% (2024).'

factual_claims.claim: Gross uplift reached DKK 4.5 million, or 12%, supported by the company’s land-and-expand strategy.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development: 'Net uplift of 7% was driven by a strong gross uplift to existing customers of DKK 4.5M, corresponding to 12%.' Management commentary: 'We achieved gross ARR uplift of DKK 4.5M in 2025, corresponding to 12% gross ARR growth on the existing customer base... our land-and-expand strategy remained solid.'

factual_claims.claim: Average revenue per account increased 8% to DKK 228,000, while customer acquisition cost rose to DKK 371,000 from DKK 222,000 and CAC payback increased to 22 months from 15 months because of higher lead-generation spending and fewer new customers.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics table: 'Average ARR per Account (ARPA) DKK 228T (2025) vs DKK 212T (2024). Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) DKK 371T (2025) vs DKK 222T (2024). CAC Payback (months) 22 (2025) vs 15 (2024).' ARR development: 'We lifted the Average ARR per Account (ARPA) to a record high level of DKK 228T... CAC of DKK 371T in 2025... higher than in 2024 as a result of increased spending in lead-generating activities... fewer new customers compared to 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Growth was led by Denmark and DACH, where net new ARR grew 22% and 26%, respectively.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Regional development section: 'In Denmark, we increased net new ARR by a growth rate of 22% YoY... Our second core market, the DACH region, led the growth with 26% growth YoY in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: The customer base exceeded 200 after 26 new customer wins, while top-10 customer concentration fell to 20% from 24%, strengthening revenue diversification.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers... we welcomed 26 new customers... top 10 customer concentration measured on ARR has decreased from 37% to 20% as of year-end 2025.' ARR development chart: 'ARR 2024 24%, ARR 2025 20%.'

factual_claims.claim: Product development included the July launch of the Control Testing module, initial AI features, and preparations for Entity Management, supporting enterprise expansion and upselling opportunities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'True to previous commitments, we have delivered on launching the Control Testing module, advancing our AI agenda from exploration to live implementation, and laying the foundations for Entity Management... The launch of Control Testing in July 2025 was a landmark milestone... AI features are aimed at meaningfully reducing the time that organizations spend managing and completing controls... Entity Management is expected to become a key platform capability for scaling Impero to even larger customers... meeting enterprise governance requirements at scale.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow also improved: cash flow from ordinary operating activities was negative DKK 1.3 million versus negative DKK 4.3 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement: 'Cash flow from ordinary operating activities DKK -1,279T (2025) vs DKK -4,252T (2024)... The improvement is primarily attributed to the stronger operating performance, reducing our cash burn from ordinary operating activities.' Financial review: 'In 2025, Impero had a negative cash flow from ordinary operating activities of DKK 1.3M compared to negative DKK 4.3M in the same period last year.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash ended at DKK 18.9 million after a DKK 15 million directed issue in December, with equity rising to DKK 15.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance sheet: 'Cash DKK 18,851T (2025)... Equity DKK 15,413T (2025).' Strategy update: 'To strengthen the capital position... Impero successfully raised DKK 15M in a private placement in December 2025... We ended 2025 with a cash position of DKK 18.9M... equity stood at DKK 15.4M as of 31 December 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Given the stronger capital position, Impero deferred its ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026 to prioritize commercial investments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Strategy update: 'With the improved capital position... the Board of Directors believes that growth investments will create more long-term value than pursuing a strategy of being cash flow positive on a recurring basis before the end of 2026. As a result, Impero has deferred its ambition of achieving positive cash flow on a recurring basis before the end of 2026... announced in Company Announcement No. 3-2026.'

factual_claims.claim: For 2026, it guides for ARR of DKK 53–57 million and EBITDA between negative DKK 2 million and positive DKK 1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026: 'By the end of 2026, Impero expects Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to reach between DKK 53M and 57M... For 2026, EBITDA is expected to be in the range of DKK -2M to +1M.'
